subject: Minecraft Java 1.8.8 collinear repeater strong-power conduction through a legacy command block into redstone dust

observed_source_semantics.repeater_strong_output: BlockRedstoneDiode.getStrongPower delegates to getWeakPower; a powered diode emits its active signal only on the exact decoded output side.
observed_source_semantics.command_block_normal_cube: BlockCommandBlock extends BlockContainer with Material.iron; BlockContainer does not override the default full-cube behavior, and Block.isNormalCube is true for an opaque full cube that does not itself provide power.
observed_source_semantics.normal_cube_power_lookup: World.getRedstonePower delegates a normal cube to World.getStrongPower, which scans neighboring blocks for strong power.
observed_source_semantics.dust_indirect_input: BlockRedstoneWire recalculation temporarily disables its own power contribution and calls World.isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered, allowing neighboring normal-cube strong power to drive the wire.

supported_relations.source: legacy repeater at the exact decoded output side of an intervening legacy command block
supported_relations.via: that immediately adjacent legacy command block acting as the normal-cube conductor
supported_relations.target: redstone wire immediately opposite the repeater across the command block

fixture_calibration.purpose: replace only the single weak physical-adjacency hop on the long candidate transport path to matched tellraw node 392,86,-63

inference_boundary: The relation is limited to a collinear repeater -> legacy command_block -> redstone_wire shape using exact decoded repeater output direction.
Comparator output, arbitrary normal cubes, non-collinear conduction, vertical conduction, side-input behavior, locking, quasi-connectivity, and generic opaque-solid conduction are not promoted.
The static edge represents an exact possible transport relation; it does not prove that the repeater was powered in a particular runtime trial.
Payload identity, command execution, client delivery, perception, comprehension, legibility, and qualitative value remain separate evidence dimensions.
